paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Headline result Eq. (3): g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL from the R parameter of 39 Galactic globular clusters, using the He mass fraction Y from low-metallicity H II regions (the paper's benchmark scenario; SBBN-Y gives 0.50e-10 and solar Y gives 0.76e-10, reported only as alternatives in Table I). The bound is mass-independent ('wide mass range'); the paper gives no explicit mass cutoff, so the flat line is drawn from very low mass up to ~10 keV, of order the HB core temperature (T ~ 1e8 K) above which Primakoff emission is Boltzmann-suppressed. Stellar bound: no dark-matter density assumption, no rescaling applied.
